tips.title: 把数据画成图，自动套图表规范
tips.copy: Turn this data into a chart.
tips.detail: 只要提到画图，Claude 会先读一套图表配色和排版规范再动手，图在浅色和深色下都好看。不用记功能名，直接说要什么图。

en.title: Turn data into a chart, styled automatically
en.detail: Mention a chart and Claude first reads a set of chart color and layout rules before drawing, so the chart looks good in both light and dark mode. No feature names to remember: just say what chart you want.

tips.title: 立一条长期自动执行的规矩
tips.copy: From now on, run the tests every time you edit code.
tips.detail: 说出想长期生效的规矩，Claude 会把它写进设置，之后由程序自动执行，不靠记性。把例句里的动作换成你自己的。

en.title: Set a rule that runs automatically from now on
en.detail: Say the rule you want to stick, and Claude writes it into your settings so a program enforces it from then on, not memory. Swap the action in the example for your own.

tips.title: 启动项目，实际操作一遍来验证
tips.copy: Run the app and show me it works.
tips.detail: Claude 会把项目真正跑起来并操作一遍，而不是只跑测试。适合改完界面或功能后想亲眼确认的时候。

en.title: Start the project and try it for real
en.detail: Claude actually runs the project and clicks through it instead of only running the tests. Good after a UI or feature change you want to see working with your own eyes.

tips.title: 做成可分享的私有网页
tips.copy: Make this a web page and give me a link to share.
tips.detail: Claude 会把结果发布成一个网页并给你链接。默认只有你能看，要分享时再自己打开权限。

en.title: Turn it into a private, shareable web page
en.detail: Claude publishes the result as a web page and gives you the link. Only you can see it by default; open up access yourself when you want to share it.

tips.title: 找现成的 skill 或插件
tips.copy: Is there a skill or plugin that already does this?
tips.detail: Claude 会在可安装的 skill 和插件里找适合当前任务的，并给出安装卡片。适合觉得“这事应该有现成工具”的时候。

en.title: Find an existing skill or plugin
en.detail: Claude searches the skills and plugins you can install for one that fits the task and shows you an install card. Good when you suspect there's already a tool for this.

tips.title: 找出当前改动里的 bug
tips.detail: 检查当前还没提交的改动，列出可能的 bug。后面可以跟力度，比如 /code-review high。

en.title: Find bugs in your current changes
en.detail: Checks your uncommitted changes and lists likely bugs. You can add an effort level, like /code-review high.

tips.title: 把改过的代码整理简洁
tips.detail: 只管代码质量：去重复、简化、提效率，并直接改好。它不找 bug，找 bug 用 /code-review。

en.title: Clean up and simplify the code you changed
en.detail: Only about code quality: removes duplication, simplifies, speeds things up, and applies the fixes. It doesn't hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.

tips.title: 检查当前改动的安全问题
tips.detail: 对当前分支上还没合并的改动做一次安全检查，适合提交或发布之前。

en.title: Check your current changes for security issues
en.detail: Runs a security review of the unmerged changes on the current branch. Good before you commit or ship.

tips.title: 少弹确认框：常用只读命令加白名单
tips.detail: 扫描你过去的对话，把经常被问“是否允许”的只读命令整理成白名单，写进当前项目的 .claude/settings.json，以后在这个项目里不再反复确认。

en.title: Fewer permission prompts: allowlist common read-only commands
en.detail: Scans your past conversations, collects the read-only commands you keep being asked to allow, and writes them as an allowlist into this project's .claude/settings.json, so you stop confirming them in this project.

tips.title: 每 5 分钟重复一条指令
tips.detail: 按固定间隔重复执行后面的指令。把 5m 换成你要的间隔，把后面的话换成要重复做的事。

en.title: Repeat an instruction every 5 minutes
en.detail: Runs the instruction after it on a fixed interval. Change 5m to the interval you want, and the rest to whatever should repeat.

tips.title: 定时在云端自动跑任务
tips.detail: 创建一个按时间表在云端运行的任务，电脑关着也会跑。比如每天早上九点整理一次。

en.title: Run a task in the cloud on a schedule
en.detail: Creates a task that runs in the cloud on a schedule, even when your computer is off. For example, a roundup every morning at 9.

tips.title: 为项目生成 CLAUDE.md 说明文件
tips.detail: 让 Claude 读一遍项目，写出一份说明文件。以后每次在这个项目里开新对话，Claude 都会先读它。

en.title: Generate a CLAUDE.md guide for the project
en.detail: Claude reads through the project and writes a guide file. Every new conversation in this project reads it first.

tips.title: 对话太长时压缩成摘要接着聊
tips.detail: 把前面的对话压缩成摘要，腾出空间继续做。适合对话很长、Claude 开始变慢或忘事的时候。

en.title: Compress a long conversation into a summary and keep going
en.detail: Compresses the conversation so far into a summary to free up room. Good when a conversation is long and Claude starts slowing down or forgetting things.
